title: Our Future Health — Questionnaire table (CD3 schemify pilot)
description: Array of OFH questionnaire response records. One element is one submitted questionnaire response (ID), linked to a participant via PID (many_to_one -- a participant may have more than one questionnaire response). Full pilot: all 359 properties across 6 categories, matching the source's own folder_path section structure.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce that PID references a real participant:PID, nor resolve the is_multi_select ambiguity flagged on 134 properties. See the README's 'Documented but not enforced' section.
